description: 40 t, 7% down at 40 km/h with service brake only (endurance brakes off), driver pumps the pedal

checks.source: pumping the pedal consumes more air (~50 NL per application, 10 chambers) than the compressor delivers (~450 NL/min at rated speed): the classic long-descent pressure loss
the service brake keeps working (pressure does not collapse within 4 min)
warning lamp comes on: real consequence of pumping on a long descent
no solver explosion / impulse spikes (per-step velocity change of either body)
